name: KLN Logistics Group Limited
summary: KLN Logistics Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides logistics services in Hong Kong, Mainland China, the rest of Asia, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Oceania. The company operates through Integrated Logistics and International Freight Forwarding segments. It offers integrated logistics services, including storage, inventory, value-added, trucking and distribution, returns management, and various ancillary services, as well as leases offices and warehouses. The company also provides international freight forwarding services to transport cargo using air freight, ocean freight, rail logistics, and cross-border road freight forwarding services. In addition, it offers express services; aviation ground; operates warehouses; transportation and distribution services; supply chain; pharmaceutical logistics; and project cargo freight forwarding, document storage, management, and trading services. Further, the company operates as an insurance broker and general merchant; provides courier services; and operates seaport. It serves fashion and lifestyle, electronics and technology, food and beverage, fast-moving consumer goods trading and distribution, food servicing, wines and spirits, industrial and material sciences, automotive, art logistics, and pharmaceutical and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Kerry Logistics Network Limited and changed its name to KLN Logistics Group Limited in April 2025. KLN Logistics Group Limited was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong. KLN Logistics Group Limited is a subsidiary of S.F. Holding Co., Ltd.
